items: The Railway Budget was merged with the Union Budget in 2017 following the recommendations of the Bibek Debroy Committee.
Bholu the guard elephant is the official mascot of Indian Railways.
The mascot and logo were unveiled on the 150th anniversary of Indian Railways in 2002.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Indian Railways was nationalised in 1951 and is currently divided into 19 operational zones.
The first passenger train in India ran between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane on 16 April 1853.
Lord Dalhousie is recognized as the Father of Indian Railways.
The Railway Board was constituted in 1905 under the tenure of Lord Curzon.
